purpose: Distinguish genuine order-book and planned-capacity numeric evidence from unrelated percentages/currency values appearing on the same page.

accepted_relation_patterns: CAPACITY_INCREASE_BY_PERCENT: capacity language and increase/expand language explicitly linked to a percentage in the same sentence
CAPACITY_FROM_TO: explicit old/from/existing/current capacity A UNIT linked to new/to/proposed/post-expansion capacity B SAME_UNIT in the same sentence or adjacent sentence pair
CAPACITY_INCREMENTAL_BASE: explicit incremental/additional capacity and explicit pre-expansion/existing capacity with identical units
rejected: capacity values with no old/new or incremental/base relationship
planned_capacity_increase_pct.unit_rule: old/new or incremental/base units must normalize to exactly the same capacity unit

accepted_relation_patterns: ORDERBOOK_VALUE: explicit company order book/orderbook/contracted backlog language linked to a currency value in the same sentence
rejected: expected future order not yet awarded
individual order value presented as total order book
orderbook_value.orderbook_to_sales_rule: an approved order-book value is only a numerator candidate; orderbook_to_sales remains missing until a separate pre-anchor revenue denominator is approved

review_policy: Only structured relation matches and source-page provenance may enter the review ledger. A reviewer must still approve/reject each relation; no automatic score is created.
